name: Necromancer: raised Skeletal Warriors hold their weapons (COA-5823)
contract: Raise: Lesser Skeletal Warrior (500970) summons 50065 and Raise: Greater Skeletal Warrior (504901) summons 51065.
Neither creature had a creature_equip_template row, so both fought bare-handed. A summon has no creature row and
Creature::UpdateEntry loads equipment ID 1 from the template, which now holds a Worn Shortsword (25) for the
Lesser Skeletal Warrior and a Worn Battleaxe (12282) for the Greater one. The metric reads the creature's
UNIT_VIRTUAL_ITEM_SLOT_ID main-hand slot, which the client draws.

steps.label: SETUP: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
SETUP: the Greater Skeletal Warrior is raised
DISCRIMINATING: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior holds a Worn Shortsword
DISCRIMINATING: the Greater Skeletal Warrior holds a Worn Battleaxe
